stories.title: The Brewers win their first World Series and dedicate it to Bob Uecker
stories.summary: Milwaukee beat the Rays 4-1 in Game 5 for the franchise's first title in 57 seasons. Closer Trevor Megill told fans to enjoy taunting Chicago next year ("We have a ring"), which sent Cubs fans into his replies.

stories.title: Every Brewers reaction after the final out of the World Series
stories.summary: MLB compiled the dugout celebration, the dogpile and the clubhouse scenes after Milwaukee clinched its first World Series title in Game 5.
